SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID id, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID text FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID
fp.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{assestType} and (fpt.TYPE_6 = #{type6_B14} OR fpt.TYPE_6 = #{type6_B15})
AND (fp.FINPROD_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) or fp.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

SELECT T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, T1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID text, T1.FINPROD_NAME, T1.FINPROD_ID, T1.CALENDAR_ID, T1.TRADE_MARKET, T1.IS_RIGHT, T2.TYPE_6, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.CCY, T3.bid_date FROM FIN_PRODUCT T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_ADD T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID

SELECT ee.PORTFOLIO_ID FROM ETR_ENTRUST ee WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID IN ( SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID IN ( SELECT PARENT_PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO WHERE PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} ) ) AND ee.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND ee.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND ee.ps = #{ps} AND ee.PORTFOLIO_ID != #{portfolioId}
select msp.counter_id from fin_product fp left join MST_COUNTER_PARTY msp on msp.link_id = fp.issuer where fp.finprod_id = #{finprodId}
select ACCT_NO ACCT_NO from PTL_CAPACCT_INFO where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and CCY = #{ccy} and ACCT_TYPE = #{acctType}
